hypothesis: The preceding lack of fresh convergence may reflect a ten-correction budget rather than a persistent association floor; thirty corrections tests only this bounded possibility
initial_state: Exactly the same saved initial poses and incoming priors as the preceding alternating comparison
data_role: already viewed development; budget diagnostic only
segment_boundary: Start a new unchanged ten-correction local call from preceding returned poses with the identical original incoming prior; no accumulated information or state commits
first_segment_control: Require complete report equality to the archived ten-correction alternating result, including all systems, poses, populations and line searches
stop: Never continue after fresh convergence or any guard; otherwise consume all three segments
terminal_checkpoint: Carry an early terminal endpoint forward explicitly rather than inventing additional updates
unchanged: Pixel association, 200-sample admission, PCA normals, symmetric residual derivative, Huber weights, prior chart, condition<=1e6, 0.1m/0.15rad proposal guards, Armijo search and strict 1e-5m/1e-5rad fresh convergence
diagnostics: Remaining full translation/rotation proposals and exact pixel turnover/cost partition over the last fixed batch at each segment endpoint; these are overlapping measured occurrences, not independent observations or physical outliers
independent_checks: Existing private raw/SVD/matrix/spectral/search/segment verifier plus independently reconstructed endpoint proposal and relative-camera/array-set turnover oracle
followup_eligibility_rule: Both cases must freshly converge all five windows, have no guards, pass every 0.03m RMS gate, and have final median fresh RMS no worse than the ten-correction control
scope: No new full-trajectory evaluation or tracker integration in this budget diagnostic
